reviews.title: 10/10 with St. Barth Commuter
reviews.text: Thank you to St Barth Commuter for going above and beyond for our flights with you. From the moment we booked, you were availabile via email to answer my many questions including luggage allowances and traveling with an infant. Check in at Grand Case was super easy and your entire team was very friendly. On the return, SBH to SXM, again, the team went above and beyond to be helpful and assist. The pilots were friendly and professional. We look forward to using your services again on our next visit.
reviews.author: Stephanie HK.
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Fantastic day trip to St. Barth
reviews.text: Taking the flight to and landing at Jean Gustaf III Airport was alays high on my bucket list. So when we where in St Maarten, I booked my wife and son on a day trip to Saint Barthélemy. First of all, Davina and Alexandra were of great help answering some questions I had regarding travel from Grand Case to Jean Gustaf III. Check in went smooth, getting a handwritten boarding card was delightful and off we went to St. Barth! The outbound flight was great and our one year old loved it too. He is a real dare devil and when the pilot started the steep decent into St. Barth, he started cheering. Heb as flying on our lap as he is still an infant. Same procedure as with every airline. The landing was perfect and every bit as cool as I expected it to be. The inbound started with us dashing full throttle on the runway, approaching the beach and sea (actually cooler than the landing) . The flight was a nice tour around the island of Sint Maarten and we also flew by Anguilla up close. Either the pilot had his girlfriend flying either him or he was hitting openly on a female passenger. Even making in air selfies from the cockpit. Nonetheless: textbook crosswind landing. Really cool to be so close to the action. Flying action, that is. All in all we had a great experience flying with the St Barth Commuter!
reviews.author: Dan
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Anti- Customer Policies
reviews.text: This airline has very customer negative policies. We are scheduled to fly to St. Bart but the local Government has announced in early February that no tourists are allowed to enter St. Bart indefinitely. Bottom line is we are not allowed to enter St Bart and St Bart Commuter is prohibited from taking us, yet the airline has refused to fully refund our airfare. We paid for a service that they are not able to deliver yet they want to penalize us and charge us for no services. This is a terrible Customer service Policy. Stay away from this airline as they don't put their customers ahead of their own profits.
reviews.author: Bill K

reviews.title: Over Two Hours Early !
reviews.text: As British Airways changed the date for our outward flight to Antigua and we were unable to amend our flight with Tradewind Aviation we decided to charter a flight with SBC to ensure we would arrive on St Barths on the same day rather than have to overnight in Antigua With our BA flight landing 30 minutes early we faced a 3 hour wait in Antigua. However, we were very pleasantly surprised to discover at check-in that our aircraft was imminently about to land in Antigua. We hurried through security and into the departure lounge and less than an hour after landing we were on our way to St Barths. 30 minutes later were on the island. We were very grateful for the flexibility shown by SBC in coming to Antigua nearly 2 and half hours ahead of the agreed departure time, and Dave, the local handling agent also deserves a special mention.
reviews.author: fatbear2000

reviews.title: Post hurricane exemplary service
reviews.text: Post Irma, navigating the airport on St. Martin can be confusing. While the local airport and airline staff have done an amazing job of running an airport under extremely challenging conditions, the staff of St Barth Commuter goes above and beyond. Everyone was friendly, extremely attentive and thorough. We were shepherded through the arrival and transfer process quickly and efficiently. Thanks so much to St Barth Commuter for starting our vacation off so well! Great job! Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Tamara S
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: They refuse to give full refunds post hurricane Irma
reviews.text: I had booked four charter planes for a special event in St. Barts for the end of November 2017. However the hotel sustained quite a bit of damage unfortunately so the party had to be cancelled. St Barth commuter would only give back 75%. They should be ashamed of themselves. They might be able to fly us from St. Martin to St. Barts,,, but we have no place to stay. Irma damaged most hotels and villas. A credit does us no good as we have moved the party venue. This is bad business practice and very disappointing. Although I have used them before I will never use them again.
reviews.author: ShariNyc_Ny
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Excellent Flight to and from St Barths
reviews.text: Great flight over to St Barths. Scenic views of the island along with friendly service at the gate made this short trip a good one. They also let me fly in the front next to the pilot, which was fun. Return flight from St Barths was also good. A bit longer route for some reason but still fun to fly so low over the ocean. Would use them again!
reviews.author: cbrislin
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Friendly Amazing Service
reviews.text: We flew to St Barths on St Barth Commuter in June and i just want to say how fantastic they were! From the moment we made our booking to the airport staff to the pilot. Our flight from Miami to St Maarten was delayed and i was sure we would miss our connect to St Barths but after flying for 28hrs from Australia it was a relief to see friendly faces in St Maarten waiting for us. They had our boarding passes printed and waiting for us. They helped us carry all our luggage and with a 16month old baby it was very much appreciated. They were quick and professional and very very friendly!! I will definitely be flying with them again when we go back!
reviews.author: lbalisson
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Private Charter
reviews.text: We recently flew on SBC on a private charter from St Barths to Antigua The flight takes around 40 minutes with just one pilot. It is all pretty low-key, and quietly efficient. Unlike Tradewind though, who also serve this route, there is no cooler box with cold drinks On arrival in Antigua, the cheerful local agent guided us through the queues and bureaucracy that is Antigua Airport.
reviews.author: fatbear2000

reviews.title: A truly wonderful short flight connecting two beautiful islands
reviews.text: OK I admit I am an aviation enthusiast, but I do not give 5 star reviews easily. This short flight to St. Barth's was a highlight of my trip to St. Martin/St. Barths. The island and ocean views were great, the approach into St. Barths and over Gustavia harbour and steep landing into the airport truly spectacular, and the return flight out over the beach and on to Grand Case equally scenic. I would highly recommend the short flight versus the ferry, motion sickness not an issue and the views are stunning. The aircraft fly comparatively low so there is lots to see and I don't know of any similar flight segment that could be as scenic. Once in St. Barths I was able to rent a car easily without a reservation. I sat behind the pilot on both segments - all staff ground +air highly polite, professional, friendly and enthusiastic, and why not? They have a good thing going. This is a great little airline and I wish them well.
reviews.author: Ian N
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: quick day trip to St Barth
reviews.text: This was the best way to take a day trip to St Barth. Our flight was scheduled to leave St Maarten at 9:30am and we were in the rental car ready to take off and explore St Barth by 9:48am. We were able to enjoy beautiful views of St Maarten and St Barth's from the sky. I highly recommend anyone interested in taking a day trip to fly with St Barth Commuter and go for the day. Keep in mind that you depart from the French side of St Maarten so they don't make announcements in English they only announce in French. We also encountered this when departing St Barth-again it is only French that is spoken.
reviews.author: luvhavinfun
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: 15 min flight with great views
reviews.text: There is no better way to get from St Barth to St Marteen than taking this short trip ( 15 min) enjoying the great views of the islands on the way. No possibility of air-sick problems. Although the cabin is mostly for 8 passengers plus the captain, you dont feel any fear of flying ( it feels like a large car that is taking off from the ground at some point). On summer days the cabin gets a little warm inside, but for such a short time it does not qualify as a big inconvenience. Also, the step-in/step-out of the plane is incredibly quick and easy.
reviews.author: Rodolfo L
reviews.route: St. Barthelemy - St Martin / St Maarten

reviews.title: Super Little Airline
reviews.text: St Barths Commuter is the local airline of St Barths and offer scheduled flights from the Island to the two Airports of St Maarten ( Julianna and Grand Case ) and seasonally to Antigua. Private Charters are also available to these destinations and other islands in the region. Fares are 70 EUR one-way to Grand Case, 75 EUR to Julianna and 300 EUR to Antigua. Flights are operated by 8 Seat Cessna Caravans and take about 10 minutes to St Maarten and 40 minutes to Antigua. SBC are my first choice from St Maarten, with the flights from the tiny Grand Case Airport very relaxing and efficient. Having flown regularly with SBC I can say they are very reliable and I have never had any issue with them. I have also taken flights from Antigua, both scheduled and private charter and the service with connecting flights has been exemplary, and I will be using this service again in August.
reviews.author: fatbear2000
